metadata.title: BARMM Health Systems Diagnostic Atlas
metadata.subtitle: Interactive findings platform for the 2026 BRIGHT-BARMM health-systems diagnostic series.
metadata.status_note: All five reports declare provisional status. Figures are for diagnostic review and should not be used for allocation, procurement, or costing until identified QA flags are closed.

findings.title: Referral completion is not yet measurable
findings.body: The consolidated field contains zero recorded referral-completion observations across 57 participating local government units, with missing data elsewhere.
findings.locator: BARMM report, finding 1; D07 referral domain

findings.title: Record quality is a shared constraint
findings.body: Only eight officers are recorded with ICD coding training and only nine of 51 electronic medical-record installations are used for statutory reporting.
findings.locator: BARMM report, finding 2; D08 FHSIS domain

findings.title: The pipeline output is not an allocation basis yet
findings.body: The consolidated evidence product carries unresolved data-build issues across all four jurisdictions, and the platform keeps those flags visible.

findings.title: First contact is a jurisdiction-specific gradient
findings.body: Registered first-contact coverage ranges from 11.0 percent in Lanao del Sur to 90.5 percent on the SGA national-register basis.

findings.title: Payment perimeter and throughput do not align
findings.body: The four jurisdictions hold 229 PhilHealth accreditations, but current throughput cannot be computed for three of the four jurisdictions.

findings.title: Inpatient capacity is uneven and ownership-sensitive
findings.body: The four jurisdictions hold 2,030 acute inpatient beds, or 0.65 per 1,000 residents, with major ownership and concentration differences.

sources.Scope / unit of analysis: Region-wide consolidation of four jurisdiction volumes
sources.Coverage as declared: 84 local government units, 1,735 current barangays and 3,137,511 residents in four jurisdictions. This is 69.0 per cent of the current PSA BARMM planning population. Basilan, Tawi-Tawi and Cotabato City are outside the workshop cycle; Sulu is outside the cycle and current BARMM.
sources.Prepared by: Lawrence John Paulo L. Trinidad  ·  Consultant, International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.Prepared under: Building Resilience through Inclusive Governance and Healthcare Transformation in BARMM (BRIGHT-BARMM), a five-year initiative, 2025–2030
sources.Evidence base as declared: PSA 2024 Census and current PSGC; 2022 NDHS historical baseline; 2025 NDHS current regional key indicators; municipal scorecards; facility register; dated PhilHealth/Konsulta returns requiring current YAKAP verification; MOH-BARMM FHSIS assessment; WHO, World Bank and workshop records.
sources.Status as declared: Provisional. This consolidation carries forward the provisional status of all four volumes. No figure in it is validated beyond the validation each volume states its own figures require, and no figure in it should be used for allocation or procurement before the ninety-day programmes at Annex B are complete.
sources.Export basis: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Manila) — Google Docs text export via Google Drive connector

sources.Report title: Lanao del Sur Provincial Health Systems Diagnostic
sources.Scope / unit of analysis: Province of Lanao del Sur (40 LGUs incl. Marawi City)
sources.Coverage as declared: Seventeen (17) local government units of Lanao del Sur participating in the Evidence-Based Decision-Making (EBDM) workshop cycle
sources.Prepared by: Lawrence John Paulo L. Trinidad  ·  Consultant, International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.Prepared under: Building Resilience through Inclusive Governance and Healthcare Transformation in BARMM (BRIGHT-BARMM)
sources.Evidence base as declared: Municipal and provincial EBDM worksheet submissions (BARMM 20260629 package), audited into 442 raw rows, 407 cleaned service-location records and 174 records with named or typed facility evidence. Facility identity, classification, accreditation and cold-chain assets remain subject to reconciliation with MOH-BARMM/DOH, PhilHealth and local records.
sources.Status as declared: Provisional. The revision establishes a cleaned service-location baseline, not a validated count of distinct facilities. Registry reconciliation and field verification remain required before allocation or procurement.
sources.Export basis: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Manila) — Google Docs text export via Google Drive connector

sources.Report title: Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Health Systems Diagnostic
sources.Scope / unit of analysis: Province of Maguindanao del Norte (12 municipalities); Cotabato City shown separately
sources.Coverage as declared: Twelve (12) constituent municipalities of Maguindanao del Norte — the full complement of the province — participating in the Evidence-Based Decision-Making (EBDM) workshop cycle, together with the City of Cotabato, which participated as an adjunct reporting entity and is not a component local government unit of the province.
sources.Prepared by: Lawrence John Paulo L. Trinidad  ·  Consultant, International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.Prepared under: Building Resilience through Inclusive Governance and Healthcare Transformation in BARMM (BRIGHT-BARMM)
sources.Evidence base as declared: Municipal EBDM worksheet submissions (BARMM 20260629 package), audited into 300 raw rows, 230 rows attributable to the twelve constituent municipalities and 207 cleaned service-location records after removal of echo and padding rows. Forty-seven further rows belong to the City of Cotabato and twenty-three to Datu Paglas, a Maguindanao del Sur municipality misfiled in the provincial workbook. Read against the national facility registry (224 records in the twelve municipalities), the DOH LGU Health Scorecard municipal dataset, the MOH-BARMM FHSIS assessment and PhilHealth returns.
sources.Status as declared: Provisional. The report establishes a reconciled service-location baseline and a first municipal master table for a province created in 2022 and not yet carried as a separate reporting unit in most national datasets. Registry reconciliation, denominator validation and field verification remain required before allocation or procurement.
sources.Export basis: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Manila) — Google Docs text export via Google Drive connector

sources.Report title: Maguindanao del Sur Provincial Health Systems Diagnostic
sources.Scope / unit of analysis: Province of Maguindanao del Sur (24 municipalities)
sources.Coverage as declared: The twenty-four (24) constituent municipalities of Maguindanao del Sur enumerated in Republic Act No. 11550, §3(b); 287 barangays; 813,243 residents at the 2024 Census
sources.Prepared by: Lawrence John Paulo L. Trinidad · Consultant, International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.Prepared under: Building Resilience through Inclusive Governance and Healthcare Transformation in BARMM (BRIGHT-BARMM)
sources.Evidence base as declared: Official statistics for all 24 municipalities (PSA 2024 Census; DOH LGU Health Scorecard; the 222-record DOH/HFSRB facility register; PhilHealth returns of July 2024; the MOH-BARMM FHSIS assessment) tested against the EBDM workshop record filed by 21 of 24 local government units. Facility identity, classification, accreditation, workforce and revenue fields remain subject to reconciliation with MOH-BARMM/DOH, PhilHealth and local records.
sources.Status as declared: Provisional. This edition establishes a municipality-level baseline on official sources. It does not adopt the provincial dashboard circulated in the 20260624/20260629 package, which represents two of twenty-four municipalities and is treated in §2.5 as a reconciliation item to be corrected before use as evidence.
sources.Export basis: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Manila) — Google Docs text export via Google Drive connector

sources.Report title: Special Geographic Area Health Systems Diagnostic
sources.Coverage as declared: The Special Geographic Area (PSGC 1999900000): eight municipalities, 63 barangays, 214,703 residents at the 2024 Census of Population. All eight municipalities are inside the evidence base. There is no absent cohort.
sources.Prepared by: Evidence-Based Decision-Making workstream, BRIGHT-BARMM, International Organization for Migration.
sources.Prepared under: The Executive Workshop on Evidence-Based Decision Making for Local Health Leaders (BRIGHT BARMM).
sources.Evidence base as declared: Municipal EBDM worksheet submissions (BARMM 20260629 package), audited into 105 raw rows and 66 cleaned service-location records; the project-held DOH facility register (68 Special Geographic Area registrations); the MOH-BARMM FHSIS unit assessment (two of eight municipalities); the draft 2024 BARMM LGU Health Scorecard; PhilHealth's July 2024 returns to IOM; and the World Bank BARMM household survey, North Cotabato stratum. Facility identity, classification, ownership, licensing and accreditation remain subject to reconciliation with MOH-BARMM, DOH-HFSRB and PhilHealth records.
sources.Status as declared: Provisional. The report establishes a cleaned service-location baseline reconciled to the 2024 Census, not a validated register of distinct licensed facilities. Registry reconciliation, licensure verification and field validation remain required before allocation or procurement.
sources.Export basis: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Manila) — Google Docs text export via Google Drive connector

jurisdictions.Basis: Sum of LGU rows on 10_Municipal_Master, excluding annexed totals and non-component references
jurisdictions.Note: Barangay figure is the 1,159-node model geography carried by Annex A; the volume also states 1,164 current barangays. Regional Table 4 records 44 units held against 68 implied.
jurisdictions.headline: Readiness cannot yet be verified province-wide.
jurisdictions.summary: The report distinguishes physical access from verified readiness. It identifies where validation and investment should begin, but does not authorize a province-wide construction or procurement envelope.
jurisdictions.first_instrument: Adopt one facility register and verify readiness before capital sizing.

jurisdictions.Basis: Sum of LGU rows on 10_Municipal_Master, excluding annexed totals and non-component references
jurisdictions.Note: Twelve component municipalities only; Cotabato City is excluded from the provincial total by the volume's own correction (§4A). Annex A carries 12 RHUs; the hospital count in Regional Table 7 is 4.
jurisdictions.headline: Referral assets sit largely outside provincial control.
jurisdictions.summary: The province has the strongest measurement apparatus in the series, but its inpatient stock and referral tier require written access and referral arrangements.
jurisdictions.first_instrument: Publish access and referral arrangements for retained and external beds.

jurisdictions.Basis: Sum of LGU rows on 10_Municipal_Master, excluding annexed totals and non-component references
jurisdictions.Note: Twenty-four municipalities. Annex A hospital column counts hospitals only; six infirmaries are carried separately.
jurisdictions.headline: The accreditation base is large, but utilization is not measured on the new boundary.
jurisdictions.summary: The province carries substantial accreditation and rural health unit coverage, but the PhilHealth return is not disaggregated after the province split.
jurisdictions.first_instrument: Obtain PhilHealth disaggregation and rebuild the provincial evidence product.

jurisdictions.Basis: Sum of LGU rows on 10_Municipal_Master, excluding annexed totals and non-component references
jurisdictions.Note: Rural health units on the register basis (9). On the operating basis the area holds 6 and the shortfall is 5. No hospital or infirmary of any class exists in the area.
jurisdictions.headline: First-contact sites exist, but payment and legal regimes remain unresolved.
jurisdictions.summary: The area reports service points in every barangay, while dated records show no accreditation line, no public inpatient tier, and unresolved fiscal and licensing regimes.
jurisdictions.first_instrument: Settle fiscal and licensing regimes, then accredit the existing network.

jurisdictions.Basis: Sum of the four jurisdiction rows above
jurisdictions.Note: Regional Annex A states 84 LGUs, 1,735 barangays, 3,137,511 residents, 89 RHUs held against 157 implied and a shortfall of 68, and 21 hospitals. Compare the live sums in this row against those printed figures.

qa_flags.Finding: The front-matter TABLES list names Table 3 (First-contact infrastructure) and Table 11 (Provincial monitoring indicators); neither appears in the body under those numbers. Table 11 is absent from the document entirely.
qa_flags.Why it binds: A monitoring framework named in the contents list but absent from the body cannot be used to baseline the two-year programme, and the volume's own indicator set is therefore unstated.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 03_Table_Index — filter Report = LDS and compare against the front-matter list.

qa_flags.Finding: Exhibits 5 and 6 appear in the body mislabelled as a second 'EXHIBIT 3' and 'EXHIBIT 4'. Exhibit 7 ('Where births actually happen') is absent from §4.9. TABLE 2 and TABLE 5 each appear twice under the same number.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Duplicate and missing labels break cross-referencing between the volume and this consolidation, and defeat citation by exhibit number.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 03_Table_Index — duplicate labels are visible on sorting by Report then Label.

qa_flags.Finding: Section 12 'Two-Year Investment Logic, 2026–2028' is listed twice, at p. 42 and p. 43. There is no §2.1 and no §8.1.
qa_flags.Why it binds: The printed page locator for §12 is ambiguous.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 02_Section_Index — both entries are carried verbatim.

qa_flags.Finding: The validation programme table has no header row and begins at item 3; items 1 and 2 are missing.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Two tasks of the ninety-day programme are unstated, so the programme cannot be costed or assigned.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: D11 sheet — the table is reproduced as it stands.

qa_flags.Finding: Lanao del Sur's Annex A preserves the 1,159-node 2020 model geography; current administrative coverage is 1,164 barangays. Annex A implies 1,159 − 1,024 = 135 barangays with a matched station; the regional volume states 128 covered of 1,164 (11.0 per cent).
qa_flags.Why it binds: The barangay denominator drives the construction volumetric for the largest jurisdiction in the series. A seven-barangay difference in the numerator and a five-barangay difference in the denominator are both unresolved.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 10_Municipal_Master column Z (live barangays with a facility) against 16_RHU_Standard_and_Coverage; 11_Jurisdiction_Rollup column I.

qa_flags.Finding: The PhilHealth Konsulta return does not foot. Registered: column sum 717,318 against a stated total of 714,318 (+3,000). First patient encounters: column sum 37,951 against a stated 32,098 (+5,853). SAP-1 paid: column sum 6,253,786 against a stated 6,253,788 (−2).
qa_flags.Why it binds: The return is the only source for Konsulta throughput. Until the return is reconciled, no conversion rate computed from it can be relied on, and the regional volume's own arithmetic-failure finding stands.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 13_Konsulta_Return — live column sums and variance rows.

qa_flags.Finding: The Special Geographic Area records zero PhilHealth accreditations of any class against a regional total of 347.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Without accreditation the area cannot draw PhilHealth reimbursement, so first-contact capacity already built cannot be financed. The volume states ₱444,926,240 as revenue that cannot be earned.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 12_PhilHealth_Accreditation — SGA column and live column sums.
qa_flags.Status: Confirmed in source; requires accreditation action, not data correction

qa_flags.Finding: Referral completion is recorded as zero observations across 57 reporting units. No jurisdiction has a published catchment map.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Referral performance cannot be measured at all. Any statement about referral in the five volumes is an inference from structure, not an observation of outcome.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: D07 sheet — Exhibit 6 reproduced verbatim.
qa_flags.Status: Open — instrument does not yet exist

qa_flags.Finding: Cold chain status is not recorded for 353 of 836 records (42.2 per cent); only 115 are recorded functional. Maguindanao del Norte never uses the category 'Partial' once.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Cold chain is the binding constraint on immunisation, and the 2024 measles outbreak is the arbitrating event. A 42 per cent unrecorded field cannot support a procurement decision.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 15_Cold_Chain — live functional and unrecorded shares, and the unaccounted-records check.

qa_flags.Finding: Cotabato City (383,383 residents, 37 barangays, 6 hospitals, 512 beds) is carried in the Annex A table but is not a component LGU of Maguindanao del Norte. The volume's §4A correction removes it from the provincial averages.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Including the city inflates every provincial per-capita and readiness measure. The regional consolidation excludes it.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 10_Municipal_Master — the row is typed 'Non-component reference' and is excluded from every SUMIFS roll-up on 11_Jurisdiction_Rollup.
qa_flags.Status: Resolved in this workbook by row typing

qa_flags.Finding: Rural health units in the Special Geographic Area are stated on two bases: 9 registered and 6 operating. The implied requirement at 1:20,000 is 11, so the shortfall is 2 on the register basis and 5 on the operating basis.
qa_flags.Why it binds: The construction volumetric doubles depending on which basis is adopted.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 16_RHU_Standard_and_Coverage — the printed cell carries both; the live recomputation uses the register basis carried in 10_Municipal_Master.
qa_flags.Status: Open — basis must be fixed before allocation

qa_flags.Finding: Two facility registers disagree: the DOH facility register records 68 Special Geographic Area registrations against a municipal enumeration of 66 cleaned service-location records, with different composition by class.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Neither register is validated. Facility identity, classification, ownership and licensing remain unreconciled.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: D04 sheet — Table 6 reproduced verbatim.

qa_flags.Finding: The workforce cannot be counted from the supplied records.
qa_flags.Why it binds: No health human resource volumetric can be derived for the area, so staffing cannot be costed in the two-year programme.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: No workforce table exists in any of the five volumes; there is therefore no workforce domain sheet in this workbook.

qa_flags.Finding: The National Tax Allotment position of the eight municipalities is unresolved, and the volume flags this as conditioning everything else.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Fiscal capacity to sustain any recurrent cost created by the programme is unknown.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: D06 sheet.

qa_flags.Finding: The regional volume carries an eleven-row register of divergences between the four jurisdiction volumes, each requiring resolution.
qa_flags.Why it binds: The four volumes were built sequentially and each corrected findings in the previous one; unresolved divergences propagate into any consolidated figure.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: D14 sheet — Annex D reproduced verbatim.

qa_flags.Finding: The rounding convention behind 'units implied by the target' is not stated in any volume. Nearest-integer rounding reproduces the printed 68 / 37 / 41 / 11 exactly; rounding up gives 69 / 38 / 41 / 11 and a regional requirement of 159 rather than 157.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Two additional rural health units across the region is a material difference in a construction volumetric, and the convention is an inference of this workbook rather than a statement of the source.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 05_Assumptions row 5; both conventions are computed side by side on 10_Municipal_Master (columns W and AD) and 16_RHU_Standard_and_Coverage.
qa_flags.Status: Open — convention should be stated explicitly in the volumes

qa_flags.Finding: The forty municipal barangay values in Lanao del Sur's Annex A sum to 1,164, but the annex's own PROVINCE row prints 1,159 and its column note states that the column preserves the 1,159-node 2020 model geography. The municipal rows are therefore on current geography while the total is on model geography.
qa_flags.Why it binds: The province total and the rows beneath it are not on the same frame. Every share computed against the provincial barangay denominator is affected, including the 11.0 per cent first-contact coverage figure carried into the regional volume.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 11_Jurisdiction_Rollup row 2, columns G to I: printed 1,159 against a live sum of 1,164, variance +5.

qa_flags.Finding: Maguindanao del Norte's Annex A hospital column sums to 6 across the twelve municipalities. Regional Table 7 records 4 hospitals and 2 infirmaries for the province. The annex column appears to combine hospitals and infirmaries; the definition is not stated. The Lanao del Sur and Maguindanao del Sur annexes count hospitals only.
qa_flags.Why it binds: Hospital counts are not comparable across the four volumes, and the regional total of 21 hospitals cannot be reproduced from the annexes, which sum to 23.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 11_Jurisdiction_Rollup columns M to O: MDN printed 4 against a live sum of 6; the four-jurisdiction row shows 21 printed against 23 live.

qa_flags.Class: Parser limitation, not a source defect
qa_flags.Finding: Several source cells carry a number with a qualifier attached — '63 matched', '9 registered / 6 operating', '1,164 current', '6 (9.1%)'. This workbook parses the leading number for computation and preserves the printed string in an adjacent qualifier column.
qa_flags.Why it binds: The qualifier changes what the number means. A reader taking the parsed value alone would treat a matched-record count as a facility count.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 15_Cold_Chain column K and 16_RHU_Standard_and_Coverage columns L and G carry the printed string verbatim.
qa_flags.Status: Resolved in this workbook by qualifier columns

qa_flags.Finding: All five reports declare themselves PROVISIONAL. They establish cleaned service-location baselines, not validated registers of distinct licensed facilities.
qa_flags.Why it binds: No figure in this workbook is validated for allocation, procurement or costing.
qa_flags.Live check in this workbook: 01_Source_Register column K carries each report's own status statement.

evidence_gaps.gap: PhilHealth Konsulta and claims data are not disaggregated on the post-2022 boundary, and the Special Geographic Area has no separate line
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: The principal financing indicator does not exist for three of four jurisdictions. Named the highest-priority request in two volumes independently.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: PhilHealth Corporate Planning / BARMM Regional Office: registrations, first patient encounters, statements of account generated and paid, 2021–2025, by PSGC, with a facility-level accreditation roster

evidence_gaps.gap: No GIDA determination for three of four jurisdictions
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Isolation was the strongest correlate of modelled access failure where it was available. Three allocation bases rest on two variables instead of three.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: DOH Bureau of Local Health Systems Development masterlist, filtered to PSGC 1908700000, 1908800000 and 1999901000–1999908000, with barangay codes and year of determination

evidence_gaps.gap: No MOH-BARMM or HFEP unit-cost schedule
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Four volumes decline to cost their programmes for want of it. Its absence is the reason the region has a defensible allocation logic and no defensible cost envelope.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: MOH-BARMM Planning Division; DOH Health Facility Enhancement Program

evidence_gaps.gap: No jurisdiction-level causes of death or morbidity
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: No cause profile, mortality rate, maternal mortality ratio or infant mortality rate can be computed anywhere in the four.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: PSA Vital Statistics Division, special request — registered deaths by ICD-10 cause, by PSGC, 2023–2024; MOH-BARMM RESU line lists; IPHO FHSIS M1/M2 returns

evidence_gaps.gap: No published service-delivery network or catchment map in any jurisdiction
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Referral completion cannot be measured and ambulance procurement has no destination. Ten municipalities in one province raised referral as a priority gap and no corresponding map was proposed.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: MOH-BARMM under the UHC-BARMM implementing rules of 26 April 2021; DOH for retained facilities; DND for camp hospitals

evidence_gaps.gap: Current DOH-HFSRB licence status for the acute inpatient stock
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Almost every licence validity date in the register has passed, including those of facilities holding 63 per cent of one province’s beds and the sole Level 2 facility of another. Licensing status is null for the majority of records in three jurisdictions.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: DOH-HFSRB current extract, cross-checked against the MOH-BARMM facilities map

evidence_gaps.gap: The issuance governing licensure of primary care facilities in a devolved region
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Determines whether accreditation of the Special Geographic Area network is a documentary exercise of months or a construction exercise of years — and whether ₱219 million a year is recoverable in Year 1.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: DOH-HFSRB; MOH-BARMM; Office of the Chief Minister

evidence_gaps.gap: The DBM per-LGU National Tax Allotment annex for Region XIX
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Settles whether eight local government units and 214,703 residents are in the allotment distribution at all, and therefore whether they have a 20 per cent Development Fund.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: Department of Budget and Management; Bureau of Local Government Finance

evidence_gaps.gap: No health workforce inventory that survives parsing in any jurisdiction
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Ratio strings are stored as headcounts in all four evidence bases. No workforce or HR-density figure from the pipeline is used anywhere in the series.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: IPHO and MOH-BARMM plantilla and deployment records; physical headcount by cadre and appointment status (field collection)

evidence_gaps.gap: Cold-chain and equipment condition at 353 service locations
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: No procurement quantity is derivable from the field as it stands. In one province the intermediate category was never used once.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: Physical verification under the validation programmes — one instrument, one scale, one enumerator per municipality (field collection)

evidence_gaps.gap: The 2024 LGU Health Scorecard raw municipal extract
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: Three jurisdictions are planning on a 2022 picture, and one indicator series — facility-based delivery — ends in 2018.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: DOH Bureau of Local Health Systems Development; MOH-BARMM

evidence_gaps.gap: No official land area for two provinces or for the Special Geographic Area
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: No density, area or facilities-per-square-kilometre figure appears anywhere in the series. Three secondary compilations give three different areas for one province.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: PSA / NAMRIA–Land Management Bureau land-area datafile for the post-2022 PSGC

evidence_gaps.gap: No MOH-BARMM issuance on health system integration, and no implementing rules for Bangsamoro Autonomy Act No. 49
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: The Code’s implementing rules were required within three months of effectivity and were not obtained. No Bangsamoro Health Code was located.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: MOH-BARMM numbered administrative orders and memorandum circulars 2024–2026; MILG-BARMM

evidence_gaps.gap: Measles case and death counts disaggregated below the undivided province
evidence_gaps.why_it_binds: The only provincial breakdown available reports 427 cases and 3 deaths for a province abolished nineteen months earlier, and no figure exists for the Special Geographic Area.
evidence_gaps.where_to_obtain: MOH-BARMM RESU; DOH Epidemiology Bureau measles-rubella case-based surveillance line lists, on the post-2022 PSGC
